title: SpaceFields to establish rocket propellant facility in Andhra Pradesh
summary: SpaceFields, a company backed by venture capital investors, is set to establish a rocket propellant processing facility in Andhra Pradesh's Anantapur district. The state government will allocate approximately 120.76 acres of land for the project. This development is part of a larger rare-earth scheme estimated to be worth ₹20,000 crore.
summary_points: SpaceFields will set up a rocket propellant processing facility in Andhra Pradesh.
The facility will be located in the Anantapur district.
Andhra Pradesh government will allocate 120.76 acres for the project.
The project is supported by venture capital investors.
This is linked to a broader rare-earth scheme valued at ₹20,000 crore.
